_note: Owners (roles assigned by the assistant, DEC-30), overrides for rules whose register row cites no database object, and docket rules that were not in the BR register. Every named object and test file is verified against the live catalog by scripts/lifecycle/gen_rules_catalogue.py.

BR-005.mechanism: the application role holds no INSERT, UPDATE or DELETE on the master code tables; no master table has a foreign key outside master except the audit columns to core.user_account

BR-017.mechanism: the marts are rebuilt from the authoritative tables (analytics.load_reporting_marts) and sixteen KPIs are reconciled to a hand-built dataset; a denormalised copy that drifted would fail that reconciliation

BR-021.mechanism: trigger trg_outreach_recipient_block (migration 037) stores a blocked recipient as blocked and refuses delivery

BR-002.mechanism: function core.create_session_with_device_limit locks the user row and counts distinct active devices against the licence entitlement

BR-003.mechanism: function core.revoke_user_session sets revoked_at and ended_at and writes the audit event

BR-006.mechanism: CHECK ck_candidate_profile_visibility allows exactly private, recruiters or public; row-level security reads it through core.can_view_candidate

BR-008.mechanism: partial unique index uq_candidate_document_primary_resume allows one active primary resume per candidate

BR-009.mechanism: CHECK constraints ck_candidate_skill_proficiency and ck_candidate_skill_experience; one claim per skill (uq_candidate_skill_profile_skill)

BR-011.mechanism: CHECK ck_organization_type; identifiers in organization_identifier (unique per country and type); ck_organization_hierarchy_not_self forbids an organisation being its own parent

BR-013.mechanism: unique constraint uq_job_questionnaire_job allows one questionnaire per job

BR-022.mechanism: CHECK ck_gig_worker_profile_verification allows unverified, verified or suspended

extensions.rule: Recruiters and other users cannot create a candidate profile for someone else; candidates register themselves (docket GAP-06)
Wallet and payment ledgers are append-only; a correction is a new entry that references the original
Profile download and view history is append-only and records actor, subject, time and credit
A wallet balance is never negative and changes only together with a ledger entry
A status column changes only along a listed transition, or is a recorded exemption
Each of the 14 sensitive action classes writes an audit event or is evidenced by an append-only ledger
Audit events cannot be updated, deleted or truncated
Personal data past its retention period is purged by a scheduled, audited job
Erasing an account anonymises the person and keeps the financial and audit records
A registration or tax identifier is stored encrypted and is unique per country and type
A profile download is charged at the listed price once per organisation and candidate
Impersonation needs a platform administrator and a reason, and is audited at start and end
An integration exchange is idempotent and dead-letters after the boundary's maximum attempts
A job can show its salary only if it has one (show_salary needs a salary); the salary stays private by default
Only a recruiter of the job's organisation, or an agency recruiter mapped to it as a client, can be assigned to its jobs
A candidate's current and expected pay are shown to recruiters only when the candidate chose to reveal them; hidden pay counts as undisclosed in a search
Gender is an optional self-declaration readable only by the candidate and administrators; it is never shown to recruiters and never a search filter

A sourced application needs source recruiter_sourced, can be created only by a recruiter of the job's organisation for a candidate they may see, and moves only to applied, shortlisted, rejected or withdrawn
Candidate keyword search returns only active, non-private profiles the searching recruiter may see, never a candidate who blocked the organisation, and only to a user acting for an organisation
